//: The origins the vault will and will not fill, as one table.
The rule lives in three places and cannot be made to live in one: the
agent decides it in Rust, the service worker and the content script each
decide it again in JavaScript because an extension cannot call into the
agent to ask, and the manifest decides a fourth time by choosing which
pages the content script is injected into at all. A gate that disagrees
with the one behind it refuses what the others would have allowed, and
that has already happened once: the native host kept testing for `https:`
after the agent had learned to accept loopback, and the localhost fill was
dead before it reached the socket.
So the cases are shared even though the code cannot be. Every gate is
tested against this file, in its own language.
